title: Optimization experiment bundle v1 (research prototype)
description: Data/formulation selection and typed parameter overrides. Not the older workflow-plugin problem_manifest.schema.json. Only allowlisted adapters execute; raw formula/LaTeX/Python strings are never interpreted as code.

path.description: Relative path to local, explicitly supplied JSON; path traversal/absolute and symlinks rejected by loader

parameters.description: Typed, adapter-validated overrides. Unknown parameters are errors, not quietly ignored.
